title: Optic Disc Assessment in Glaucoma

steps.tx: **Optic disc** assessment in glaucoma reads neuroretinal rim, cup contour, nerve fibre layer and disc haemorrhages stereoscopically through dilated pupil or imaging. Rim pallor exceeding cupping suggests neurological disease over glaucoma because glaucoma cups more than pales early. Colour therefore discriminates disc cupping aetiology at first examination.
steps.say: Rim reading together gives glaucoma disc assessment at fundus clinics for adults with suspicious cups. Pallor gives neurological redirection additionally. Stereo gives contour value.

steps.tx: **Neuroretinal rim** thinning focal notch at inferior or superior pole with corresponding fibre wedge and field defect completes glaucomatous triad correlation. Structure function correlation therefore validates disc reading before progression labelling. Disc photograph baseline anchors serial comparison better than drawing memory across years.
steps.say: Structure function correlation together gives disc validation in glaucoma follow up at imaging clinics over years. Photograph gives baseline anchoring additionally. Notch gives focal evidence.

steps.tx: Disc size measurement corrects cup ratio interpretation because large discs carry large physiological cups and small discs hide glaucoma in small cups. Vertical diameter by slit beam or imaging therefore accompanies ratio in records. **Small disc danger** is undercalling glaucoma where ratio looks reassuring numerically.
steps.say: Disc size together gives ratio correction in disc records at glaucoma screening for adults with small discs. Small cup gives hidden danger additionally. Measurement gives record completeness.

steps.tx: **Disc haemorrhage** flame shaped at rim margin associates progression and normal tension disease, transient weeks so serial photography catches more than single examination. Its presence lowers target and shortens review even where fields stable currently. Haemorrhage therefore is action finding, not descriptive curiosity, in glaucoma notes.
steps.say: Haemorrhage action together gives target lowering in glaucoma follow up at disc clinics for progressing adults. Transience gives photography value additionally. Stability gives false comfort warning.

steps.tx: Axons pass through a sieve on their way out of the eye, and pressure bends the sieve. The **lamina cribrosa** is that perforated scleral plate, its pores carrying nerve bundles while its beams take the strain of intraocular pressure. Posterior bowing compresses and starves axons at this choke point. This is why damage concentrates at the disc even though pressure fills the whole eye evenly.
steps.say: The lamina cribrosa is the perforated plate axons cross leaving the eye. Raised pressure bows it backward and injures bundles at that choke point.

steps.tx: Imaging nerve fibre and ganglion complex thickness quantifies structure where disc reading subjective, tomography thinning maps corresponding field sectors. Structure may progress before field in early disease, field before structure in some advanced patterns. **Both modalities** therefore trend in glaucoma, neither dismissed by single normal result.
steps.say: Both modalities together give glaucoma trending in early disease at imaging clinics for adults under surveillance. Sector mapping gives correlation additionally. Single normal gives insufficient reassurance.

steps.tx: Myopic discs tilt, enlarge and peripapillary atrophy confound rim reading needing glaucoma specialist correlation in high myopes from refraction lesson. Tilted insertion mimics thinning where anatomy oblique. **Myopic caution** therefore qualifies disc rules in young high myopia screening. Refraction and axial length therefore accompany disc referral letters in young suspicious cases.
steps.say: Myopic caution together gives disc rule qualification in high myopia screening at glaucoma clinics for young adults. Tilt gives mimicry awareness additionally. Correlation gives specialist value.

steps.tx: Progression at disc by rim loss or haemorrhage may precede field change requiring target revision without waiting functional loss in preperimetric progression. Event comparison to baseline photographs therefore scheduled even where fields automated trend quiet. **Photograph cadence** is glaucoma visit structure, not archive luxury.
steps.say: Photograph cadence together gives progression capture in glaucoma visits at disc clinics for adults under targets. Rim event gives revision trigger additionally. Field quiet gives insufficient delay reason.

steps.tx: Anchors disc: size corrects ratio, rim order and notch localise, haemorrhage acts and pallor redirects neurology. Photography baselines progression, imaging quantifies fibres. **Cup with pallor** phrase therefore leaves glaucoma pathway in disc differential teaching. Imaging reports therefore state disc size and rim interpretation together rather than ratio alone.
steps.say: Size correction together gives disc reading accuracy in glaucoma examinations for students reliably in screening cases. Haemorrhage gives action additionally. Pallor gives exit pathway value.
